name: Las Vegas
lede: Four of us, whenever we get to it, and a long list of things we could do: skydiving, a tank, the Grand Canyon from the air, and the desert on the days the Strip wears thin. No dates yet, and none of it is booked.
blurb: Four of us, dates still open. Ideas rather than a plan: what things cost, how long they take, and no obligation to do any of them.
description: Four of us in Vegas, dates still open. Skydiving, tanks, the Grand Canyon by helicopter, odd museums and the desert. Ideas, not a plan.
